answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The knoll is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the wharf. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. By the lagoon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
